name: Notes help
description: Help mode entries for the Notes browser plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: Every note you asked Claude to save, in one place on the hub: handoffs, session logs, plans, install notes and saved commands. Pick one on the left to read it.

entries.title: New note
entries.text: Makes a new note in the folder you pick and opens it for editing.

entries.title: New folder
entries.text: Adds a folder to the notes. Notes can be moved into it afterwards.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Reads the notes again from the hub, to pick up notes another session just saved.

entries.title: Search notes
entries.text: Shows only the notes whose title or text contains every word you type.

entries.title: Sort notes
entries.text: Newest puts the most recently changed notes first; Name sorts them by title.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Turns the note into editable text. Save only goes through when nobody else changed the note since you opened it; otherwise reload it first.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves your changes to the hub. The old text is kept in the hub's history.

entries.title: Rename
entries.text: Gives the note a new name (and folder, if you pick one). Its history stays on the hub.

entries.title: Move to
entries.text: Moves the note to another folder.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Asks first, then takes the note out of the notes. The hub keeps its last text in its history.

entries.title: Reload the note
entries.text: Someone else saved this note after you opened it. Reloads their version so you can redo your change on top of it.

entries.title: Newest
entries.text: Sorts the notes so the most recently changed come first.

entries.title: Name
entries.text: Sorts the notes by title, A to Z.

entries.title: Note text (Markdown)
entries.text: The note's text while Edit is on. Markdown: # for headings, - for lists, backticks for code.

entries.title: Note title
entries.text: The new note's title; it also becomes its file name.

entries.title: Folder
entries.text: The folder the note goes in.

entries.title: Notes settings
entries.text: Where the notes are kept, and the plugin's install and uninstall panel.

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: Shows the “Notes” part of this screen. Part of Notes.

steps.say: Every note you asked Claude to save is here, sorted into folders on the left.
Search finds a note by any word in it. Tap one to read it; switch Edit on to change it.
